topic: Recalculating German data and anomaly checks
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on recalculating historical data for German facilities and reviewing anomaly detection functionality. Initially, the goal was to update a model using raw data from four specific facilities (3901, 3898, 3900, 3897) for November 10-12.

Later, it was decided that historical data could be retrieved directly from the production environment rather than solely relying on the ML staging table. The speaker confirmed access to data starting September 24th and manually moved the remaining three days of data.

Separately, a request was made to delete existing German data in the staging area and re-upload all data to smooth out observed peaks. It was confirmed that this upload is possible. Regarding anomaly detection, it was noted that while the system works, the initial 14 days are used for base building (sigma), and the performance over 30 days seems incomplete.
decisions: Historical data for German facilities will be updated using raw data from the production environment.
The staging dataset can be used to re-upload all German data to smooth out peaks.
action_items: Check and confirm the anomaly detection system's performance over 30 days.
